# Creating a 2D Array

#### Course: Learn Java Basics

## Creating a 2D Array

Here's how we can create a two-dimensional array:

```java
int[][] data = {
    {2, 3, 5},
    {7, 14, 21},
    {1, 3, 5}
};
```

Here,

- data is a two-dimensional array.
- [][] - represents 2D array.
- { {2, 3, 5}, {7, 14, 21}, {1, 3, 5} } - elements of 2D array

- [][] - represents 2D array.
- { {2, 3, 5}, {7, 14, 21}, {1, 3, 5} } - elements of 2D array

![2D Array with 3 rows and 3 columns](data:image/png;base64,)

We can see each element of the array is an array itself.

For simplicity, you can think of an array as a table with 3 rows, each with 3 columns. So, all together, this array has 9 elements (rows * columns)

Note: We can also create multidimensional arrays like this:

```java
int[][] data = { {2, 3, 5}, {7, 14, 21}, {1, 3, 5} };
```

However, we have created it like a table to make it easier to visualize.
